respins.how_it_works:
This is the MONEY SYMBOL. It appears only on the middle reel.
 At every spin, the MONEY SYMBOL takes a random value of 1x to 20x total bet.
 Possible values are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 11x, 12x, 14x,
 16x, 18x or 20x total bet.
 HOLD & SPIN
 Whenever 3x hit in the middle reel it triggers the HOLD & SPIN BONUS.
 When the feature starts the symbols on the middle reel remain in place and the symbols on the other reels fade
 away.
 The value of all MONEY SYMBOLS on the middle reel are added to the total win of the round.
Start with 3 RESPINS. All MONEY SYMBOLS that hit after each respin reset the number of respins back to 3 and the
 value of each MONEY SYMBOL on the screen is added to the total win of the round.

wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
FREE SPINS
 Hit 3 or more SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature.
 5x SCATTER awards 20 free spins
 4x SCATTER awards 15 free spins
 3x SCATTER awards 10 free spins
 During the FREE SPINS feature each WILD symbol also collects all the values
 from FISH MONEY symbols on the screen.
 All the WILD symbols that hit during the feature are collected until the end of the round.
 Every 4th WILD symbol collected, retriggers the feature, awards 10 more free spins and the multiplier for MONEY
symbol collection increases to 2x for the first retrigger, 3x for the second retrigger and 10x for the third retrigger.
 The retriggered spins are played after the previous batch of free spins ends.
 The multiplier applies to the retriggered spins.
 After the third retrigger, the feature cannot be retriggerd anymore.
 Randomly, when there are one or more WILD symbols on the screen, at the end of a free spin, fish MONEY
 symbols can appear in random positions on the screen replacing current symbols from that positions.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.
 The maximum win amount is limited to 5,000x bet. If the total win of a FREE SPINS ROUND reaches
 5,000x the round immediately ends, win is awarded and all remaining free spins are forfeited
  VOLATILITY

 This is the DIAMOND MONEY SYMBOL. It appears only on reels 1, 2, 4 and 5
 in the HOLD & SPIN ROUND. Whenever it hits it takes a random value from
 100x to 4993x total bet.
 Possible values are: 100x, 200x, 300x, 400x or 4993x.
 During the HOLD & SPIN round a win of minimum 20x total bet is guaranteed. If there are no more respins left and
 the win was not yet reached, 3 more respins are awarded.
The round ends when there are no more respins left. When the feature is complete the total value collected so far is
 awarded.
 Special reels are in play during the respin round.

 The fish paying symbols are also FISH MONEY symbols. At every spin, the fish take
 a random money value which can be won during the FREE SPINS feature.
 Possible values are: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 2.5x, 5x or 500x total bet.
